Fusinus thermariensis is a species of marine gastropod mollusc that belongs to the Fasciolariidae family, popularly referred to as the spindle snails and their relatives. The species is distinguished by its relatively large size of shell, where the largest shells found have been reported at about 54.7mm in length.
